data.title: Organic Design
data.tagline: Create warmth through natural material, real people, and a gentler pace
data.description: Organic design uses flowing curves, irregular shapes, material texture, and earth colors drawn from nature, contrasting with strictly geometric form. It often appears in food, wellness, home, and sustainability-oriented brands, but organic describes a formal visual language and does not automatically mean environmentally responsible. Product origin, service promises, and the next action still need specific expression.

use: Food, wellness, fragrance, and home brands where material and use context are part of the value
Small-batch craft and sustainable products whose origin and process can lead the story
Hospitality, restaurants, and slow travel where real space and people create expectation
Personal services and studios that need warmth and care alongside expertise
avoid: Turn every surface beige ; without material, content, and typographic relationships, the result is only flat
Use natural and pure instead of facts ; explain material, source, and actual practice
Place texture over body text ; paper and grain belong behind the reading layer
Make the action disappear in the quiet mood ; purchase, booking, and contact still need clear affordance

data.agentPrompt: Organic design brand website, earth tones and forest green, flowing natural curves and irregular shapes, authentic nature and craft-process photography, serif display type with readable sans-serif body, subtle paper grain, specific origin and material information, clear purchase or booking action
